questions.question: What happens to net exports when domestic income rises?
questions.explanation: The source states that net exports decline when domestic income rises (Q0005).

evidence.quote: Why do net exports decline when domestic income rises?

original_segments.text: It's a function of output, and it's a decreasing
function of output.
Why is that?
Of domestic output.
Domestic output, domestic income.
Why is it a decreasing function of domestic income?
Why do net exports decline when domestic income rises?
They import more.
They consume everything more, but part of that is import.
And so part of that energy of an extra demand goes to foreign goods and that's what deteriorates net exports, okay?
And that's the reason we said, how do we just stop there, make the net export function just a function of output
We would have not needed all these extra paratus
I'm about to build because all that would have meant is that just we have a smaller multiplier
It would have been exactly the same as we did in the closed economy
But with a smaller multiplier because you know every time output goes up now part of that demand goes to
foreign goods rather than domestic goods.
